overview: Mykapo is a star system in the Deep Core, within the Zuma Sector, at galactic grid I-11, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Mykapo appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Deep Core.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Mykapo's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Mykapo is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Deep Core chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Deep Core sector records
